content.description: Diagram showing a press and SST (Special Service Tool) being used to press the release bearing from the hub. Arrow indicates downward press direction.

items.label: (a)
items.text: Using a press and SST, press the release bearing from the hub.

content.description: Diagram showing a press and SST being used to press a new release bearing into the hub. Arrow indicates downward press direction.

items.label: (b)
items.text: Using a press and SST, press a new release bearing into the hub.

items.label: (c)
items.text: After installing the bearing, check that there is no drag on the bearing when it is turned under pressure.

content.description: Diagram showing installation of disc on flywheel using SST. Shows front view with arrow indicating direction and side view of clutch disc on flywheel.

content.text: Using SST, install the disc on the flywheel.

content.description: Diagram showing clutch cover installation with numbered bolt positions (1-6) and a wrench tightening one of the bolts.

content.text: Tighten the bolts evenly and gradually. Make several passes around the cover until the cover is snug. Torque the bolts.

content.description: Diagram showing checking of diaphragm spring tip alignment using a feeler gauge and SST. Shows hands using tools to measure gap between spring tips.

content.text: Using a feeler gauge and SST, measure the gap between the spring tips and the tool.
If gap is excessive, adjust as follows.
